title: Kahani: Culturally-Nuanced Visual Storytelling Tool for Non-Western Cultures

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative user study where participants from various regions of India annotated and rated AI-generated text and visual stories (from Kahani vs. ChatGPT-4 with DALL-E 3). The evaluation measured cultural nuances, use of Culture-Specific Items (CSIs), and the accuracy of cultural elements in visuals using Likert scale ratings (analyzed via Wilcoxon signed-rank tests), composite scores, and BLEU- and MQM-inspired metrics.
